name: Greenland Holdings Corporation Limited
summary: Greenland Holdings Corporation Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the real estate development business in China, Hong Kong, Macau, Taiwan, and internationally. It operates through the Real Estate and Related Industries; Consumer and Producer Services Industries; Financial Investment Industry; Large Infrastructure Industry; and Other Business segments. The company develops residential, high-rise buildings, large-scale urban complexes, high-speed rail new towns, characteristic towns, international convention and exhibition centers, and modern industrial parks; and undertakes infrastructure projects, including rail transit, highways, and municipal bridges.
